title: Minimum trees on a lot under 700 m2: 1 medium and 2 small (Table 1.2a)
text: Tree Canopy. C1.2.4 A minimum number of trees to be planted in accordance with Tables 1.2a and provided with the required deep soil area per tree in accordance with Table 1.2b. Table 1.2a Minimum tree provisions. Lot size less than 700m2: 1 medium tree and 2 small trees.

replaces.note: R10-R25: 2/3/4 trees on 2 m x 2 m pits -> sized trees with deep soil

notes: from: ch3 C1.2.4. diverges: Table 1.2a here (p10) is the lot-size table of small, medium and large trees (current Part C multiple dwellings), not the frontage-based street setback and per-dwelling small trees of Chapter 3. Lot under 700 m2 (rule condition). Counts are the trees planted across the development lot by Table 1.2b size, excluding the C1.2.5 parking shade trees; a retained significant tree counts like-for-like by its size (C1.2.6 note). The table does not say whether a larger tree may stand in for a smaller one, so it is tested literally (verify). For R10-R25 apartments this is a step up from Part B (C4P1-011).

verified.note: Table 1.2a (p10) does not say whether a larger tree may stand in for a smaller one (e.g. a large tree for a required medium tree); counts tested literally.
